title: Student grade point average
statementMd:
Compute each student's average score (graded enrollments), rounded to 1 decimal. Show the top five students; break ties by name.

Expected columns: `name`, `avg_score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT s.name, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 1) AS avg_score FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY avg_score DESC, s.name LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
